}}'''Maeva Estévez Baux''' (born 2 March 1995)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Olympedia – Maeva Estévez |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/2300008 |access-date=2026-01-14 |website=[[Olympedia]] |archive-date=19 January 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250119213327/https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/2300008 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Maeva ESTEVEZ BAUX - Athlete Biography - Snowboard |url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sectorcode=sb&competitorid=166160&type=result |access-date=2026-01-14 |website=FIS |language=en |archive-date=9 August 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250809130435/https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sectorcode=sb&competitorid=166160&type=result |url-status=live }}</ref> is an Andorran retired [[Snowboarding|snowboarder]] who specialises in [[snowboard cross]].

At the [[2012 Winter Youth Olympics]], Estévez competed in the girls' [[Snowboarding at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics – Girls' halfpipe|halfpipe]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Qualification results |url=https://medias1.fis-ski.com/pdf/2012/SB/7625/7625RLRQ.pdf |access-date=2026-01-15 |website=fis-ski.com |archive-date=2 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250602133540/https://medias1.fis-ski.com/pdf/2012/SB/7625/7625RLRQ.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> and [[Snowboarding at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics – Girls' slopestyle|slopestyle]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Qualification results |url=https://medias1.fis-ski.com/pdf/2012/SB/7167/7167SLRF.pdf |access-date=2026-01-15 |website=fis-ski.com |archive-date=17 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240717043218/https://medias1.fis-ski.com/pdf/2012/SB/7167/7167SLRF.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> events. Estévez participated in the [[2022 Beijing Winter Olympics]] in the women's snowboard cross event, where she placed 31st overall<ref>{{Cite web |title=Final results |url=https://medias2.fis-ski.com/pdf/2022/SB/6071/2022SB6071RLF.pdf |access-date=2026-01-14 |website=Data.fis-ski.com |archive-date=9 February 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220209111334/https://medias2.fis-ski.com/pdf/2022/SB/6071/2022SB6071RLF.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> after suffering a fall in her heat.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Maeva Estevez avança positivament en la recuperació de la lesió al genoll |url=https://www.altaveu.com/actualitat/esport/maeva-estevez-avanca-positivament-en-recuperacio-lesio-genoll_41745_102.html |access-date=2026-01-14 |website=Altaveu |language=ca |archive-date=20 April }}</ref> She was the Andorran [[List of flag bearers for Andorra at the Olympics|flag bearer]] at the opening ceremony.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2022-01-21 |title=MAEVA ESTÉVEZ, classificada per Beijing 2022 |url=https://www.coa.ad/maeva-estevez-classificada-per-beijing-2022/ |access-date=2026-01-14 |website=Comitè Olímpic Andorrà |language=ca |archive-date=23 January 2022
